```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the iris dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot with seaborn
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue="species", diag_kind="kde", palette="husl")

# Add titles and labels
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset Pairplot', y=1.02)
pairplot.set(xlabel='Measurements', ylabel='Measurements')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
